judgment_text:
Prayer : Petition filed under Article 226 of the Constitution of India praying to issue a writ of habeas corpus to call for the records relating to the detention order dated 28.08.2025 passed by the second respondent in his proceedings No. Cr.M.PNo. 73/Goonda/2025 and quash the same and direct the respondents herein to produce the petitioner's son namely Dhachinamoorthi, son of Sundararajan, aged about 9 years, who is presently under going detention in the Central Prison, Coimbatore, as Goonda before this Court and set him at liberty forthwith.

The Order of the Court was delivered by

Dr Anita Sumanth, J.:— Mr. R. Muniyapparaj, learned Additional Public Prosecutor, states that nothing survives in this matter as the detention order in Cr.M.P. No. 73/Goonda/2025 dated 28.08.2025 passed against the detenu has been revoked by the Government by its order in G.O. Rt.No. 6635 Home, Prohibition and Excise (XII) Department, dated 15.10.2025, recording which, this Habeas Corpus Petition is closed. No costs.
